title: # REQUIRED. The class name as a seeker should read it.
country: REQUIRED. Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. DE.
city: REQUIRED. Town or city. An online class is placed in it, too.
address: Required for offline. Street address, without the city or country.
state: State, province or region. Improves the address match where a city name repeats.
venueName: The building or hall, where it has a name a seeker would look for.
room: Room or floor within the venue.
description: Plain text. Line breaks become paragraphs.
contactName: Published as entered — the name a seeker sees.
contactPhone: Published as entered. Include the country code.
languages: Comma-separated locale codes, e.g. "de,en". Blank uses the batch default.
managerName: The class manager's name. Used only when managerEmail names a new account.
managerEmail: The manager who vouches for this class. Blank publishes it unverified.
recurrenceType: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY. Blank for a one-off class.
date: REQUIRED. YYYY-MM-DD: the date of a one-off class, or the first occurrence.
weekdays: Weekly classes only: the days it meets, from MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA,SU. Blank uses the weekday of the date.
interval: Repeat every N days, weeks or months. Blank means every one.
untilDate: YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means the class repeats indefinitely.
